candidate.answerReason: Peter ate 1/12 of the pizza plus half of another 1/12, totaling 1/12 + 1/24 = 1/8.

methods.label: Combine the two portions
methods.explanation:
One slice is \(1/12\) of the pizza. Peter also ate half of another slice, which is
\[
\frac1{12}\div2=\frac1{24}
\]
of the pizza. His total share was
\[
\frac1{12}+\frac1{24}
=\frac2{24}+\frac1{24}
=\frac3{24}=\boxed{\frac18},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
